objective: Implement app.py answer() returning 42 in the isolated worktree

non_functional_requirements.description: The module is importable with the installed Python and has no imports or extra dependencies

acceptance_criteria.description: The approved command checks imports, loads the function, and verifies its result

argv: import ast; from pathlib import Path; tree=ast.parse(Path('app.py').read_text()); assert not any(isinstance(n,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom)) for n in ast.walk(tree)); from app import answer; assert answer()==42
